title: QMagma.jl: A Julia package for 1D thermal modeling of repeated sill injection
description: QMagma.jl is a one-dimensional thermal model of repeated sill injection. It compares discrete sill emplacement with an equivalent, time-averaged Q_magma source, tracking melt fraction, passive tracers, eruptions, and zircon crystallization ages, with a GLMakie graphical interface.
